newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA WIN TOSS, BAT AGAINST AUSTRALIA.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SOUTH AFRICA WIN TOSS, BAT AGAINST AUSTRALIA.

text.p: South Africa won the toss and
chose to bat against Australia in the sixth one-day day
international at Centurion Park on Thursday.
South Africa - Adam Bacher, Herschelle Gibbs, Daryll
Cullinan, Jacques Kallis, Jonty Rhodes, Hansie Cronje (captain),
Derek Crookes, Shaun Pollock, Dave Richardson, Rudi Bryson,
Australia - Greg Blewett, Mark Waugh, Stuart Law, Michael
Bevan, Steve Waugh, Adam Gilchrist, Ian Healy (captain), Shane
Warne, Adam Dale, Andrew Bichel, Jason Gillespie.
